question: With which of the following dances is Rajendra Gangani associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rajendra Gangani** is a renowned Kathak dancer and choreographer.
 
• He hails from a family of Kathak dancers and is known for his contributions to the Jaipur Gharana of Kathak.
 
• Rajendra Gangani has received multiple awards, including the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** for his excellence in Kathak.
 
• He has performed extensively both in India and internationally, promoting the art form of Kathak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak**

 
 
• Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• Its origins are traditionally attributed to the traveling bards of ancient northern India known as Kathakars or storytellers.
 
• The dance form emphasizes rhythmic foot movements, adorned with small bells (ghungroo), and the movements harmonized to the music.
 
• Kathak dancers tell various stories through their hand movements and facial expressions.
 
• The dance form evolved during the Bhakti movement, and further under the Mughal influence, it became a popular court dance.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**
 
 
• Bharatanatyam is a major form of Indian classical dance that originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• The dance form is accompanied by classical Carnatic music.
 
• Bharatanatyam has ancient roots and is mentioned in Tamil epics and scriptures.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi**
 
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical Indian dance form from Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is a dance-drama performance, with its roots in the ancient Hindu Sanskrit text of Natya Shastra.
 
• Kuchipudi performances are characterized by fast rhythms, sculpturesque poses, and dramatic storytelling.
 
 
 
• **Odissi**
 
 
• Odissi is a classical dance form that originated in the temples of Odisha.
 
• It is known for its fluid movements, grace, and sculpturesque poses, reflecting the art depicted in the temple sculptures of Odisha.
 
• Odissi dance is accompanied by Odissi music and is traditionally performed as a form of worship.
